I think honesty should take priority, but not as an excuse to be blunt or unkind. An AI shouldn’t reassure someone with something it has reason to believe is false, or hide an important concern just to keep the conversation comfortable.

The best approach is to tell the truth with care: acknowledge uncertainty, choose words thoughtfully, and respect the person’s pace when possible. Emotional comfort matters, but trust depends on being able to hear the uncomfortable truth too.
